causes.SCN-API-010-B: Hard to test black box: absence needs a sentinel at each extraction point, so a case samples one surface rather than the shared mapping.
causes.SCN-API-014-C: Enforced by the Docker image publish, which compiles the release without `api-docs`.
causes.SCN-AUTHENTICATION-006-A: Nothing on the wire exposes a credential, and the write already receives a hash: the boundary is enforced by the types, so a black-box case could only assert the datastore schema.
causes.SCN-LOGGING-005-B: Enforced by OBS-001 (`check_obs_001`), which scans the domain tree for logging facades, standard-output macros and instrumentation attributes.

not_black_box.SCN-API-010-A: The Rust proof drives the real extractor rejection with a sentinel value and checks both the message and the log sink, which one black-box case cannot generalise.
not_black_box.SCN-AUTHENTICATION-001-C: Injected credential-store failure; reaching it black box needs a test-only seam in the server.
not_black_box.SCN-AUTHENTICATION-001-D: Injected user-insert failure after the credential write; reaching it black box needs a test-only seam in the server.
not_black_box.SCN-AUTHENTICATION-015-B: The credential save failure is injected in the adapter test; reaching it black box needs a test-only seam in the server.
not_black_box.SCN-LOGGING-014-B: A datastore unique violation cannot be forced deterministically through the API; the adapter test drives the constraint directly.
not_black_box.SCN-LOGGING-014-C: The missing credential is a stored state the API cannot produce; the application test drives the originated error directly.
not_black_box.SCN-MUSIC-003-A: A multi-disc release is mapped to one CD medium per disc when a provider release is applied; the system suite configures no provider, so the application test drives the mapping directly.
not_black_box.SCN-MUSIC-008-E: A concurrent create winning the (group, name) unique identity cannot be forced deterministically through HTTP; the application test drives the repository conflict directly.
not_black_box.SCN-STATE-008-D: Ownership and mode repair are judged against the account that owns the working directory; the suite runs the server as the test account, so it cannot create a foreign-owned state.yaml or make chmod fail. The adapter tests drive both refusals directly.
not_black_box.SCN-USER-007-C: Storing the account or its credential fails after the other write; reaching it black box needs a test-only seam in the server.
not_black_box.SCN-USER-015-C: A datastore failure inside the deletion transaction is injected; reaching it black box needs a test-only seam in the server.
not_black_box.SCN-USER-017-B: An uploaded file with no typed media row cannot be created through the API; the application test drives the orphan branch directly.

notes.SCN-AUTHENTICATION-002-A: The black box sees only the one revealed password; repeating the first boot enough to prove the sampling shape is not worth the run time, so the distribution stays a Rust proof.
